options.text: What am I meant to be doing again?

steps.player: What am I meant to be doing again?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Enter the Theatre and beat the challenges within. Doing so would cause great embarrasment to Verzik, and my associates would very much appreciate it.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

steps.player: Okay, thanks.
What's all this really about?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.player: Well you don't really expect me to believe you're just here to embarrass Verzik do you? What's really going on?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: My associates prefer to keep their intentions to themselves. However, if you were to assist us with another matter, I might be able to share more.

steps.prompt: Start the A Night at the Theatre quest?

steps.player: What do you need?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Your suspicions are correct. My role here is not to embarrass Verzik Vitur. Instead, my associates have a long history with Verzik, and have sent me here to keep an eye on her.

steps.player: So you're spying on her? Then why are you asking people to go and 'embarrass' her?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Research.

steps.player: Research?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Yes. As you're aware, of all those that go into the Theatre, the vast majority never come out. That said, some have managed to succeed. Of course, the vampyres would never let the citizens know this.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Thanks to these successes, I've been able to gather information on Verzik and her abilities.

steps.player: Ah, so they're the ones that have been doing the spying. Still, that doesn't explain what this is all for.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Verzik has abilities unlike any other vampyre. However, she did not always possess these abilities. My associates are keen to discover how she obtained them.
If the player has beaten Verzik before:

steps.player: You mean that thing she does where she turns into a spider?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Exactly.

steps.player: Right, I think I understand now. So where do I come in?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: These were recently recovered from within the Theatre. Take a look at them.
The Mysterious Stranger shows you some eggs.

steps.player: Eggs?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Not just any eggs. These are the eggs of a nylocas, one of Verzik's arachnid pets.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Normally this wouldn't be anything special. After all, Verzik has hundreds of nylocas. However, these eggs are from a variant we've never encountered before.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: What's more interesting than that though is how they were obtained. For lack of a better description, the mercenary who recovered them claimed they 'fell out' of Verzik herself.

steps.player: Verzik laid some eggs?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Apparently so.

steps.player: How lovely. I think you've safely put me off my food for the rest of today. So you think these eggs are somehow connected to her unique abilities?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: It would line up with some suspicions my associates have had for a while.
If the player hasn't beaten Verzik before:

steps.player: And I suppose you want me to look into this?

steps.text: If the player has beaten Verzik before:

steps.player: Not to mention the whole turning into a spider thing I guess. I suppose you want me to look into this?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: That is correct. I also believe you have a friend who can help.

steps.player: I have a friend?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: A dead one.

steps.player: Ah, that sounds about right. Which dead friend are we talking about here?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Ranis Drakan.

steps.player: Right... And how's a dead vampyre going to help us exactly?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: My kind have the ability to relive our memories as if they are happening again. We can also relive the memories of others if we are able to make physical contact with them. I could show you if you want?

steps.player: Please don't go poking through my memories. Also, what do you mean by 'your kind'?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: I am not at liberty to say.

steps.player: Of course. How silly of me. And you want to relive Ranis' memories I'm guessing? Will that even work now that he's dead?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: We are lucky that vampyre corpses deteriorate slower than many other species. Enough of his brain should still be intact for me to work with.

steps.player: Err... Nice. What's he got to do with these eggs though?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Ranis and Verzik were close friends. He interacted with her more than anyone else did. Getting close enough to Verzik to observe her own memories will be... problematic. He is the next best option.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Within his memories we can hopefully learn more about Verzik and her abilities. As for the eggs, they are our catalyst.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: It would take years to search through all of Ranis' mind, but I can use these eggs to help us find relevant memories much faster.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Now, I must remain here. That means you will need to recover Ranis for us.

steps.player: And where can I find him?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Luckily for us, Ranis always loved the Theatre. As such, he is actually buried deep below it. You can use the staircase to the north east to access his crypt.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Be careful, it's well guarded. Even other vampyres are not allowed in. I suggest you take that flail of yours.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Also, you don't need to bring his whole body back of course. That wouldn't be very subtle. We only need his brain.

steps.player: Brains are generally attached to the body you know.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: I know. That's why I'd recommend you take a saw.

steps.player: Oh... Oh god.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Good luck.

steps.player: Actually, I'm not that interested.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: As you wish. Return to me if you change your mind.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

steps.player: Not yet.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Return to me when that changes.

starting-off-if-the-player-has-cleared-t.player: Yes! After beating all of her challenges, she chose to face me herself. I couldn't fully defeat her though. She just transformed into a bat and flew away.

starting-off-if-the-player-has-cleared-t.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
starting-off-if-the-player-has-cleared-t.text: Very impressive. I had a feeling you would have what it takes.

starting-off-if-the-player-has-cleared-t.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
starting-off-if-the-player-has-cleared-t.text: Verzik will be back soon enough. Death will not come easy for her. However, you have still been of great use to my associates.

options.text: Speaking of your associates, what's all this really about?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger

steps.player: Where can I find Ranis?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: You can use the staircase to the north east to access his crypt. Remember, you don't need to bring his whole body back. We only need his brain. I'd recommend you take a saw.

steps.player: I think I want to be sick.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

entering-ranis-crypt-obtaining-ranis-hea.player: Well this is probably one of the more disgusting things I've ever done. Here goes nothing...

entering-ranis-crypt-obtaining-ranis-hea.text: You get to work on removing Ranis' head.
You successfully remove the head of Ranis Drakan.

entering-ranis-crypt-obtaining-ranis-hea.player: Hey there Ranis. Didn't expect to see you again. How are you doing?
Well I think I might be at my lowest point in life right now. I really need to find a hobby or something.

entering-ranis-crypt-searching-coffin-wi.text: You search the coffin and find the head of Ranis Drakan, but you don't have enough room to take it.

entering-ranis-crypt-searching-coffin-wh.text: You search the coffin and find the headless body of Ranis Drakan. Lovely.

entering-ranis-crypt-getting-the-head-ag.text: You search the coffin and find the head of Ranis Drakan.

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

options.text: I managed to recover Ranis' head.

steps.player: I managed to recover Ranis' head.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Good work. Hand it over.
If the player lost the head:

steps.player: Well... I seem to have lost it.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: You should probably go and find it again then.
You give Ranis' head to the Mysterious Stranger.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Hmm... Yes, I think this will work.

steps.player: So what now?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: It seems that Ranis has many memories of these eggs, or at least of something very similar. Thanks to my abilities, we can view these memories. Hopefully they will reveal the truth about Verzik.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Now, I suggest we start at the beginning. Take my hand.

steps.player: Why are you making this weird?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: I require physical contact to share the memory with you.

steps.player: Oh... Fair enough.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Prepare yourself!
The first of Ranis' memories are displayed in the player's mind. Ranis Drakan, at The Maiden of Sugadinti's chamber, is seen with a vyrewatch.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Do you have them?

steps.speaker: Vyrewatch
steps.text: Right here, my lord.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Excellent. I will take them from here.

steps.speaker: Vyrewatch
steps.text: Of course.
Ranis Drakan walks towards Verzik Vitur.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Ranis my dear, how wonderful to see you.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: And you Verzik.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: I see you've wasted no time in introducing our new guest to the Theatre.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: I must say, I find the name you've given her to be quite interesting. Not the kind of thing I'd have expected from you.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Well I thought it would be quite humorous.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: I see. So you intend to use her as a new challenge?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: It seemed an ironically fitting role for her, given that fun little narrative you came up with. Besides, with all the work you put in, it would have felt wrong to just abandon her.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: You should not have worried about that. The things we learnt from her down in the labs more than made up for the effort.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Well either way, I'm glad she's here. I've found her to be quite the inspiration. Thanks to her, I've decided to give the whole place a bit of a sprucing up.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: You're replacing all the challenges?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Absolutely! Those old ones were getting dull. It's time for some fresh excitement in this place.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Well perhaps I have something that can help with that. I have a gift for you.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: A gift? Oh Ranis you do spoil me!

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: You can thank Lowerniel for this one. He found these eggs in an arachnid nest north of Darkmeyer. He thought you might be able to use them in your nylocas breeding program.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: How exciting! Do pass on my thanks. He is always welcome to come and pay me a visit himself, of course.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: The Theatre has never really been his thing.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Oh Ranis, I do love your brother, but he is such a bore! He needs to learn to live a little!

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Anyway, tell me more about this nest.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: The arachnids there are highly unique. Lowerniel thinks their queen might be of a higher power.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: A higher power? He doesn't think that silly stone he used to have is involved, does he?

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: No, he suspects something more natural.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Really? Well either way, if he's right, these eggs could be key to some very exciting new nylocas.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: I look forward to seeing the results.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: As do I...
The cutscene ends.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Interesting... Very interesting...

steps.player: That was Verzik?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: It was. However, the memory was from many years ago, before she gained her unique abilities.

steps.player: I see. So what's our next step?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: The eggs in that memory were very similar to the ones in my possession, but they were not identical. It sounded like Verzik intended to use them to breed new nylocas.

steps.player: Perhaps that breeding is what led to the eggs you have.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: And perhaps it was also the starting point for Verzik's abilities.

steps.player: How can we be sure?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: We will need to recover some of those eggs for ourselves. With them, we may be able to find further relevant memories.

steps.player: Ranis said they came from a nest north of Darkmeyer. I'll see if I can find it.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Good idea. I will remain here.

steps.player: Any reason why you're not able to join me?
Actually, let me guess. Your associates...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: My associates would prefer I remain here.

steps.player: I'm not sure why I asked. I'll be back once I've explored this nest.

steps.player: Alright. I'll be back once I've explored this nest.

the-strange-spider-eggs-attempting-to-op.text: You try to rip open to egg sac, but it's too strong.

the-strange-spider-eggs-searching-the-sk.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.text: You search the skeleton and find a sticky note.

the-strange-spider-eggs-searching-the-sk.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: You search the skeleton and find a sticky note, but you don't have enough room to take it.

steps.player: Got any sulphuric acid?

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: What? What for?

steps.player: Well I was exploring a cave west of here and I think I found your assistant.

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: I was wondering where she got to. Where is she now?

steps.player: Ah yes... About that...

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: Well?

steps.player: Well... she's dead I'm afraid. Looks like the spiders in the cave killed her. Ate most of her as well...

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: What a disaster! It's going to take forever to find a new willing assistant who's competent as well.

steps.player: Yeah... Oddly enough I can't imagine many people will be queueing up to go get themselves eaten by spiders for you.
Still, if it helps, it looks like she did find what she was after. There's an egg sac near where I found her. If I had some sulphuric acid, I could melt through it.

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: Well I suppose I can give you some. Consider it a thank you for bringing me the news about my assistant.
If the player has no inventory space:
Daer Krand tries to give you some sulphuric acid, but you don't have enough room to take it.

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: Come back when you have some room for it.
If the player has inventory space:
Daer Krand gives you some sulphuric acid.

steps.player: Thanks! Want me to bring you some of those eggs?

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: No, it's fine. I'll send my new assistant to get me some... Once I find a new assistant anyway.

steps.player: Got any sulphuric acid?

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: Yes, here you go.
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: Come back when you have some room for it.
If the player has inventory space:
Daer Krand gives you some sulphuric acid.

steps.player: Thanks!
Got any sulphuric acid?

steps.text: If the player still has the acid:

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: Looks like you already have some.

steps.player: Oh... So I do. Thanks.

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: Did I not already give you some?

steps.player: Maybe?

steps.speaker: Daer Krand
steps.text: Oh... Well I suppose I can spare some.

steps.player: Thanks!

You take some strange spider eggs from within the egg sac.

steps.text: You search the egg sac and find some strange spider eggs, but you don't have enough room to take them.

the-strange-spider-eggs-taking-the-egg-s.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.text: You search the egg sac and find some strange spider eggs.

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

options.text: I found some of those eggs.

steps.player: I found some of those eggs.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Excellent. Let's have a look at them.
If the player lost the eggs:

steps.player: I don't actually have them with me.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Well I'll need you to bring them here. They could be key to understanding Verzik's abilities.
You give the strange spider eggs to the Mysterious Stranger.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Hmm... How curious...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: I believe I can use these new eggs to help us find more memories of note. Hopefully they will start to present a clearer picture for us.

steps.player: Well that would be nice. I'm still a bit lost to be honest... Then again, I guess that's just the norm for me.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Once we're done, I'll also have the eggs sent to my associates. Assuming they do have a connection to Verzik's abilities, they will come in very useful.

steps.player: Your associates aren't trying to replicate her powers are they?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Oh quite the opposite. Their hope is to find a way to counteract them.

steps.player: Interesting...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Anyway, I think I have found a new memory for us.

steps.player: Let's take a look.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Prepare yourself!
Ranis' second memory is viewed. Ranis, alongside Verzik, meet in the Pestilent Bloat's chamber.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Bloat? Not the most elaborate of names, is it?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: A crude name for a crude creation.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Well it's most definitely crude... Quite disgusting as well.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Turns your stomach, does it Ranis? I'm surprised you'd find anything disgusting after what you did to that girl.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: I just think it's important to take a bit of pride in your work. This is a Theatre, Verzik. We should be producing art!

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Ranis darling, I couldn't agree more. Come have a look at this.
Ranis and Verzik walk towards a Nylocas Athanatos.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: A new nylocas?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: The athanatos! Isn't it magnificent!

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: It's quite a sight to behold.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: I have you and Lowerniel to thank for this one. This is the result of those eggs you gave me.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: I'm glad you were able to make good use of them.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Oh I've been able to work wonders with them, and I'm not done yet. If all goes well, the athanatos will be just the beginning...
The cutscene ends.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: So Verzik did manage to use those eggs to create new nylocas. However, something is still missing.

steps.player: Is there another memory that could tell us more?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Yes, I believe there is. Let us see what it can tell us.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Prepare yourself!
Ranis' third memory is viewed. Ranis, alongside Verzik, meet in the nylocas chamber.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: My my... You've really outdone yourself this time.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Ranis you flatterer!

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: So was this one also the result of those eggs?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Much more boring I'm afraid. I still have plans for those eggs, but I'm missing a key aspect right now. Don't worry, I'm sure I'll get it worked out.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Perhaps I can help. What are you missing?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Oh Ranis, you're not trying to steal my thunder are you?

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Verzik, you know I wouldn't...

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Just joking Ranis! I know you're far too noble for that.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: The thing I need is something with the ability to regenerate. Nylocas are strong in numbers, but far too weak on their own.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Hmm... I think I know just the thing. When we created the Maiden, we experimented heavily in that area.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Ah, of course. You and your haemalchemy.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Well in the end it wasn't actually haemalchemy that gave us the answer. It came in the form of a gift from the old queen.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Not another of her plants was it?

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Precisely that! Specifically the hespori. Their bark has wonderful regenerative abilities.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: I see... Yes, I think that might just work. Thank you, Ranis.
The cutscene ends.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Hespori... Of course.
If the player has grown a hespori before:

steps.player: I've grown a hespori before!

steps.text: If the player hasn't grown a hespori before:

steps.player: What's a hespori?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: They are remarkable plants with a will of their own. Not to mention their many unique properties...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: They were grown here back when this place was still known as Hallowvale. The Saradominist Queen of the region used them as weapons against the vampyres.

steps.player: You know your history.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: More than most.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: It sounds like the vampyres found multiple uses for the hespori. Not only did they play a part in the creation of the Maiden of Sugadinti, but they were also potentially used to make a new nylocas.

steps.player: I'm guessing this is the bit where I retrieve some hespori bark for us.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: You are correct. However, I'd suggest you collect some from a naturally occuring hespori rather than one you've grown yourself.

steps.player: Do you know where I can find one?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: They are native to Morytania, but they are quite rare. I'm afraid I'm not an expert on nature.

steps.player: Hmm... I know of a nature spirit who lives in the swamp. He can probably help.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Perfect. I will await your return.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

options.text: So we have the eggs. Now what?

steps.player: So we have the eggs. Now what?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: I believe I can use these new eggs to help us find more memories of note. Hopefully they will start to present a clearer picture for us.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

options.text: That memory didn't tell us too much.

steps.player: That memory didn't tell us too much.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: It seems Verzik did manage to use those eggs to create new nylocas. However, something is still missing.

steps.player: Is there another memory that could tell us more?

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

steps.player: That memory seemed more useful.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Indeed. It seems a hespori is key to our next steps.
If the player has grown a hespori before:

steps.player: I've grown a hespori before!

steps.text: If the player hasn't grown a hespori before:

steps.player: What's a hespori?

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

options.text: Where can I find a hespori?

steps.player: Where can I find a hespori?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: I'm not sure. They are native to Morytania, but they are quite rare. You mentioned a nature spirit who could help.

steps.player: That's right! He lives in the swamp.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Then you should go and speak to him. I will await your return.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.speaker: Nature Spirit
the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.text: Welcome back, my friend. I sense that you need my help with something.

the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.player: That's right! I'm looking for a hespori. I was hoping you might know where one is.

the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.speaker: Nature Spirit
the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.text: Ah, a hespori. They're wonderful plants. Why are you looking for one?

the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.speaker: Nature Spirit
the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.text: I see... Well do be very careful. Hespori are rare enough as it is without people damaging them.

the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.player: Yeah... I'm definitely not going to damage it in any way.

the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.speaker: Nature Spirit
the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.text: Yes! I can sense the presence of a hespori near here. It's to the north east, on a small island in the swamp.

the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.speaker: Nature Spirit
the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.text: For you my friend, it is no problem at all.

the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.speaker: Nature Spirit
the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.text: Welcome back, my friend. Did you find that hespori?

the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.player: Can you remind me where it is?

the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.speaker: Nature Spirit
the-hespori-bark-talking-to-the-nature-s.text: I can sense it to the north east, on a small island in the swamp.

the-hespori-bark-chopping-the-hespori.text: If the player does not have a proper axe:

steps.text: To chop the hespori, you'll need an axe that you have the Woodcutting level to use.

the-hespori-bark-chopping-the-hespori.text: If the player has not previously killed the Hespori:

steps.text: (The Hespori attacks.)

the-hespori-bark-chopping-the-hespori.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: Your inventory is too full to do that.

the-hespori-bark-chopping-the-hespori.text: If the player does not already have bark:

steps.text: You chop some bark from the hespori.

the-hespori-bark-chopping-the-hespori.text: If the player already has bark:

steps.text: You already have some hespori bark.

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

steps.player: I found a hespori.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Perfect. Do you have some bark from it?
If the player does not have the bark:

steps.player: Not yet.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Then you should go and recover some. Be careful, for it will likely fight back. I will await your return.
You give the hespori bark to the Mysterious Stranger.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Excellent. This is just what we needed.

steps.player: Can it help us find more memories?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Yes, I think so. Let me see what I can find...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Ah, here we go. I believe we're getting close now.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Prepare yourself!
Ranis' fourth memory is viewed. Ranis, alongside Verzik, meet in Sotetseg's chamber.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Power over the Shadow Realm you say? That takes me back to the old empire.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: That was the inspiration. Alas, the experiments didn't really go anywhere in the end.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Such a pity. Still, he will make for a fine new challenge here. As always Ranis, you are far too generous.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Speaking of experiments, did you think any more on my hespori suggestion for that new nylocas?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: That I did. It's going very well so far. Still too early to be sure, but I think this could be the one.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: The one?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Absolutely! The nylocas to end all nylocas.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: That's quite the ambition. So when do we get to see the results?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Patience now Ranis. You can't rush perfection. It won't be long now, I'm sure of it...
The cutscene ends.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Interesting, but not overly illuminating. Still, we are not far off now.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: There is one final memory. Let us hope it provides the answers we seek.

steps.player: Alright. Let's take a look.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Prepare yourself!
Ranis' fifth and final memory is viewed. Ranis, alongside Verzik, meet in Xarpus' chamber.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: The last King of the yarasa... I never thought I'd see one of their kind again.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Does this mean Lowerniel finally found a way home?

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: It would seem so, but he did not enlighten me on how he did it.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Fascinating...

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Anyway, I have something you simply have to see. Come take a look.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Is this...?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: This is the one Ranis. This is my new Queen Nylocas. All that work has finally paid off.

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: It's very small.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Oh don't worry darling, it will grow. I'll have to come up with a fancy name as well.
The spider bites Verzik, and dies.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Ouch! You little...

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Oh...

steps.speaker: Ranis Drakan
steps.text: Not what you were expecting?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: I really thought this was the one...

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Back to square one I guess. What a waste.
The cutscene ends.

steps.player: That was it? She made a new nylocas, it bit her and it just died?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: We have still gained a lot here. That bite almost certainly led to her abilities, and we know how the nylocas variant responsible was created.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: We even have the relevant materials as well. Between them and the knowledge we now have, my associates should be able to begin work on new weapons and techniques to use against Verzik.

steps.player: But who knows what may have happened after that bite... What if we're missing some key information?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: I admit, while hopefully not essential, clarity on what happened next would be very useful. However, Ranis has no further memories of use to us. There's likely to only be one place to find the truth now.

steps.player: You mean Verzik herself?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Correct. But for me to gain access to Verzik's memories, I'd need to make physical contact with her. That would require us to enter the Theatre, something I was quite keen to avoid.
If the player has completed a Theatre of Blood raid previously:

steps.player: I've made it through the Theatre before. I could do it again.

steps.text: If the player has not completed a Theatre of Blood raid previously:

steps.player: I've never made it through the Theatre before, but I'm sure I can manage it.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: True, but I am no fighter. However...

steps.player: What is it?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: I know that there have been times when groups have entered the Theatre and had members not actually participate in the challenges.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Provided the more able members of the group succeed, these individuals are still considered to have beaten the challenge.

steps.player: So you want me to 'carry' you through the Theatre?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: That is an apt way of putting it. If you can get me to Verzik, I should hopefully be able to extract the memories we need. The moment of defeat will be my best opportunity, when she is weakest.

steps.player: Okay, I think we can make this work.

steps.text: If the player has completed a Theatre of Blood raid previously:

steps.prompt: As you've completed the Theatre of Blood before, you can choose to skip this section if you wish.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: You can still take other people in as well of course. Just use the notice board to set up a party and find suitable allies. Once you're ready, I will join you in the Theatre.

steps.player: In that case, I'll see you in there.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

options.text: Can we use this bark to find more memories?

steps.player: Can we use this bark to find more memories?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Yes, I think so. Let me see what I can find...

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

options.text: Do you have any more memories for us to look at?

steps.player: Do you have any more memories for us to look at?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: There is one final memory. Let us hope it provides the answers we seek.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

options.text: This Verzik business kind of feels like it's been a waste of time.

steps.player: This Verzik business kind of feels like it's been a waste of time.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: How so?

steps.player: Verzik made a new nylocas, it bit her and it just died. That was it.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: We have still gained a lot here. That bite almost certainly led to her abilities, and we know how the nylocas variant responsible was created.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
talking-to-the-mysterious-stranger-after.text: You again. What can I do for you?

steps.player: Ready to enter the Theatre?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: I am. Remember, you need to get me all the way to Verzik herself and then defeat her. When she is at her weakest, I should be able able to extract the memories we need.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Don't forget you can use the notice board to find suitable allies to join us if you don't feel comfortable doing this alone. I will join you inside once you are ready.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

a-night-at-the-theatre-after-each-wave.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-after-each-wave.text: You fought well. Now, let us move on. We have to reach Verzik so that I can extract her memories.

a-night-at-the-theatre-the-maiden-of-sug.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-the-maiden-of-sug.text: The Maiden of Sugadinti. Such an ironic name.

a-night-at-the-theatre-the-maiden-of-sug.player: What do you know about her?

a-night-at-the-theatre-the-maiden-of-sug.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-the-maiden-of-sug.text: Not much more than you probably know yourself. Hers is a tragic tale of misguided hope.

a-night-at-the-theatre-the-maiden-of-sug.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-the-maiden-of-sug.text: You might find it useful to know that she's a powerful user of magic. Unsurprisingly, blood magic is her specialism. I hear she also has a habit of using nylocas to further increase her power.

a-night-at-the-theatre-pestilent-bloat.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-pestilent-bloat.text: The Pestilent Bloat. What a disgusting monstrosity.

a-night-at-the-theatre-pestilent-bloat.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-pestilent-bloat.text: Nothing fancier than some crude necromancy. Still, that doesn't mean it's not dangerous. Don't even try to take it head on. Wait for the perfect moment and attack while it is weak.

a-night-at-the-theatre-nylocas.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-nylocas.text: Some types. Alone they're not overly dangerous, but you'll never encounter them alone. Their power is in numbers.

a-night-at-the-theatre-nylocas.player: So how do I overcome that?

a-night-at-the-theatre-nylocas.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-nylocas.text: Different variants have different weaknesses. Prioritise your targets, and ensure you use the right weaponry against them.

a-night-at-the-theatre-sotetseg.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-sotetseg.text: Sotetseg. One of the greater mysteries of this Theatre.

a-night-at-the-theatre-sotetseg.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-sotetseg.text: He's some sort of modified dark beast. No dark beasts have ever been encountered in Morytania, so who knows how the vampyres got him here. Perhaps he is not of this world at all...

a-night-at-the-theatre-sotetseg.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-sotetseg.text: Be careful, for he has a strong affinity with the shadow realm. He will almost certainly use it against you. Expect the unexpected.

a-night-at-the-theatre-sotetseg.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-sotetseg.text: Yes. Survivors of the Theatre have spoken of some sort of strange shadowy maze.

a-night-at-the-theatre-xarpus.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-xarpus.text: The once great King of the yarasa. This prison is such a sad end for Xarpus.

a-night-at-the-theatre-xarpus.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-xarpus.text: Death would be preferable to a life of imprisonment. The Theatre is a testament to that.

a-night-at-the-theatre-xarpus.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-xarpus.text: Anyway, we are close now. Defeat Xarpus, and the path to Verzik is clear.

a-night-at-the-theatre-xarpus.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-xarpus.text: He will attempt to power himself up before he fights. Try and stop that where you can. Once the fight begins, be careful of his highly poisonous attacks.

a-night-at-the-theatre-verzik-vitur.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
a-night-at-the-theatre-verzik-vitur.text: You fought well. Now, only Verzik awaits. Remember, you must fully defeat her for me to have a chance to extract her memories. Let us proceed once you are ready.

the-final-memory-talking-to-the-mysterio.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
the-final-memory-talking-to-the-mysterio.text: You again. What can I do for you?

options.text: Did you manage to get any useful memories from Verzik?

steps.player: Did you manage to get any useful memories from Verzik?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Yes and no. I have a memory that I believe has answers for us. However, it is not Verzik's memory.

steps.player: What?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: I think it's best if I just show you.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Prepare yourself!
The memory plays. Verzik, flying from the ceiling, appears.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Doctor... are you still there?

steps.speaker: Vulcan Orvoros
steps.text: I'm right here, my lady. I was just finishing my notes.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: I feel... I feel... wrong.

steps.speaker: Vulcan Orvoros
steps.text: My lady, as I've already said, we really should take you to my surgery in Darkmeyer. Whatever that nylocas did, it was no normal bite.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: No! This is my home! You will not take me!

steps.speaker: Vulcan Orvoros
steps.text: I understand. My notes are finished now. I will leave you in peace.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Peace? Yes...
The doctor leaves.

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: Doctor... It's... inside me!

steps.speaker: Vulcan Orvoros
steps.text: My lady?

steps.speaker: Verzik Vitur
steps.text: I can feel it! Help me!
Verzik explodes and blood splatters about. In her place, the Nylocas Queen and many nylocas appear.

steps.speaker: Vulcan Orvoros
steps.text: What...

steps.speaker: Nylocas Queen
steps.text: Come... Come my pretties...

steps.speaker: Nylocas Queen
steps.text: Destroy the witness... Let us dine on his corpse!

steps.speaker: Vulcan Orvoros
steps.text: No!

steps.speaker: Nylocas Queen
steps.text: The rule of the vampyres is over... The rule of the nylocas has begun...
As the cutscene fades to black, spiders can be heard attacking the doctor, killing him. The memory ends here.

steps.player: Verzik... She died!

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: We feared the worst, but we never anticipated something like this.

steps.player: But does this mean... the Verzik in the Theatre...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: ...is really just that nylocas in disguise. We must inform my master at once.

steps.player: Your master? So these associates you've been going on about... they don't actually exist do they?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: They do not. My master preferred that I keep his involvement a secret, but I feel you are now trusted enough to meet him.

steps.player: Meet him? Where?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: In a similar way to how my kind can relive our memories, we can also communicate across great distances.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Another of my kind is with my master. Through the two of us, you will be able to speak with him.

steps.player: Okay, I think I understand.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: Prepare yourself!
The player and the stranger enter their mind threshold.

steps.player: Well this is weird.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: It can take some getting used to. Now, I will contact my master and inform him of what we have discovered. Once I am done, I expect he will want to speak with you.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
steps.text: There. Now, when I next speak, it will be my voice you hear. However, the words are from my master.

steps.player: Okay...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Master
steps.text: Greetings my child. It is good that we are finally able to speak, for you have done a great service to me and my disciples.

steps.player: It would be nicer if we could speak in person.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Master
steps.text: If that were possible, we would make it so. There are many constraints upon us. Still, these constraints are often to our benefit.

steps.player: How so?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Master
steps.text: We share many common enemies, you and I. Enemies that infest Hallowvale like a disease.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Master
steps.text: By remaining far away from this disease, I keep us all safer. Instead, my disciples act as my eyes, ears, and hands upon Gielinor. They are the harbingers of my will.

steps.player: So where are you then?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Master
steps.text: Home.

steps.player: Right... And what's your connection to Verzik?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Master
steps.text: She was an old foe. We will not weep for her demise.

steps.player: What about this nylocas that's replaced her?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Master
steps.text: A concerning development. However, you have gathered all that we need to overcome it when the time is right.

steps.player: When the time is right?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Master
steps.text: When the time is right.

steps.player: So there's nothing further for us to do now?

steps.speaker: Mysterious Master
steps.text: No. For now, we must wait. But once again, you have my thanks. My disciple will ensure you are suitably rewarded. Know that you are now a friend of Sugadinti.
The player returns to Ver Sinhaza.

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

the-final-memory-talking-to-the-mysterio.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
the-final-memory-talking-to-the-mysterio.text: You again. What can I do for you?

steps.player: Verzik... She died!

options.text: Can I get those teleport crystals you mentioned?

claiming-quest-rewards-with-inventory-sp.speaker: Mysterious Stranger
claiming-quest-rewards-with-inventory-sp.text: You again. My master is very impressed with your work. On his behalf, allow me to reward you.
4 Antique lamp (A Night at the Theatre)
